summary: Live unauthenticated GET requests to the Realtime Database root, activeSessions, and launcherProfiles each returned HTTP 401. Source rules deny activeSessions reads and writes and require a non-anonymous, email-verified, UID-matching Firebase account for launcherProfiles, with field-level validation; authenticated access was not exercised. Existing activeSessions records were not deleted. Anonymous Authentication remains enabled for compatibility with shipped clients.
